record.office: Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Virginia
record.t: Has served on the Supreme Court of Virginia since Aug. 2, 2011, and as chief justice since Jan. 1, 2026.
record.q: Powell, August 2, 2011-present (Chief Justice January 1, 2026 – present) Oil on linen canvas, 25 x 32 in., by Vicars Lynn McKinney, 2013.

record.office: Justice of the Supreme Court of Virginia
record.t: Was sworn in on August 2, 2011, after being elected by the General Assembly on July 29, 2011 to a 12-year term.
record.q: Elected by the General Assembly on July 29, 2011 to a 12-year term beginning August 1, 2011, filling the vacancy created by the death of Leroy Rountree Hassell. Sworn in on August 2, 2011.

record.t: Was named to the Virginia Court of Appeals in 2008, the first African American woman on an appellate court in the state.
record.q: Named to the Virginia Court of Appeals in 2008, Powell was the first African American woman to sit on an appellate court in the state.

record.t: Served as a Judge of the Twelfth Judicial Circuit from 2000 to 2008 (2000).

record.office: Senior Assistant Attorney General of Virginia
record.t: Served as a senior assistant attorney general in the Equal Employment Opportunity and Personnel Division from 1986 to 1989.
record.q: Powell entered the public sector in 1986 where she served as a senior assistant attorney general in the Equal Employment Opportunity and Personnel Division until 1989.
